0211__L14_Sul_156__14F2582A.mp3.asr_text: Get on that radio. Tell the skipper the Marines have taken Shuri Castle. Pulaski, Turner, Jackson. Secure the area.
0211__L14_Sul_156__14F2582A.mp3.translation: 接通无线电，告诉上尉，陆战队拿下首里城了。波隆斯基、特纳、杰克逊，控制住周围。
0211__L14_Sul_156__14F2582A.mp3.note: Pulaski疑似Polonsky，人名统一波隆斯基；skipper按陆战队语境译为上尉。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 接通无线电，告诉上尉，陆战队拿下首里城了。波隆斯基、特纳、杰克逊，控制住周围。

0212__L14_Sul_12__741D07C5.mp3.asr_text: Push through it! We've got to get to cover!

0216__L14_Sul_21__75C3C8E3.mp3.asr_text: We need to get closer to that castle gate! Keep moving!

0217__L14_Sul_24__75EE0F66.mp3.asr_text: Looks like we're going right down their damn throats, Marines! Move up!
0217__L14_Sul_24__75EE0F66.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，这下要直捣老巢了！往前压！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，这下要直捣老巢了！往前压！

0218__L14_Sul_32__7786B903.mp3.asr_text: Pick your targets! Make every round count!
0218__L14_Sul_32__7786B903.mp3.translation: 看准目标！每一发都要打准！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 看准目标！每一发都要打准！

0219__L14_Sul_44__7957C0A4.mp3.asr_text: Miller! Set a charge on that gate! That's an order!
0219__L14_Sul_44__7957C0A4.mp3.translation: 米勒！去城门上装炸药！这是命令！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 米勒！去城门上装炸药！这是命令！

0220__L14_Pol_45__22EEEAC2.mp3.asr_text: Miller's going for the touchdown! Keep him covered!
0220__L14_Pol_45__22EEEAC2.mp3.translation: 米勒要冲线得分了！掩护他！
0220__L14_Pol_45__22EEEAC2.mp3.note: 保留touchdown的球赛调侃，译为冲线得分。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 米勒要冲线得分了！掩护他！

0224__L14_Sul_53__7AFE81C2.mp3.asr_text: Watch out! More enemies charging from the gate!
0224__L14_Sul_53__7AFE81C2.mp3.translation: 小心！又有敌人从城门冲出来了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 小心！又有敌人从城门冲出来了！

0225__L14_Sul_55__7B1AB0C4.mp3.translation: 他们冲上来了！拦住他们！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 他们冲上来了！拦住他们！

0226__L14_Pol_60__2612267B.mp3.asr_text: Enemy to the east! Over by that gate!
0226__L14_Pol_60__2612267B.mp3.translation: 东边有敌人！那座门旁边！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 东边有敌人！那座门旁边！

0228__L14_Sul_63__7CB35A61.mp3.note: Buy some cover疑似Find some cover，按寻找掩护口令修正。

0230__L14_Pol_65__26589C00.mp3.asr_text: The walls! Get behind the walls!

0231__L14_Sul_69__7D07E767.mp3.asr_text: MG, top of the staircase to the northeast!

0232__L14_Sul_71__7E4C03FE.mp3.asr_text: Take cover! Polanski, take it out!
0232__L14_Sul_71__7E4C03FE.mp3.translation: 找掩护！波隆斯基，干掉它！
0232__L14_Sul_71__7E4C03FE.mp3.note: Polanski疑似Polonsky，人名统一波隆斯基。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 找掩护！波隆斯基，干掉它！

0234__L14_Sul_83__801D0B9F.mp3.asr_text: Get in there, Marines! Go! Go! Go!

0236__L14_Ma1_86__4050A7EF.mp3.asr_text: More of them! On the walls!

0239__L14_Pol_101__93BCE88D.mp3.asr_text: Take cover behind those low walls!

0240__L14_Sul_99__82267144.mp3.note: 本条ASR为继续推进，与AM旧稿的It's a trap不同；明确采用ASR，不补陷阱台词。

0242__L14_Sul_104__0C4DEE0D.mp3.asr_text: Ah! It's an ambush! Take cover!

0243__L14_Pol_105__93F54691.mp3.asr_text: Get down! Incoming fire from that building!
0243__L14_Pol_105__93F54691.mp3.translation: 趴下！那栋楼里有人开火！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 趴下！那栋楼里有人开火！

0244__L14_Pol_121__972699CB.mp3.note: ASR为简短语气声，译文按应答拟写，待听音。

0246__L14_Sul_124__0FB79F4B.mp3.asr_text: Negative. Something doesn't feel right, though.
0246__L14_Sul_124__0FB79F4B.mp3.translation: 没有，不过总觉得哪里不对。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 没有，不过总觉得哪里不对。

0247__L14_Pol_132__98E989EB.mp3.asr_text: Place has already been hit by a couple of strays.
0247__L14_Pol_132__98E989EB.mp3.translation: 这地方已经挨过几发偏弹了。
0247__L14_Pol_132__98E989EB.mp3.note: strays按偏离目标的炮弹理解，待结合画面校对。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 这地方已经挨过几发偏弹了。

0252__L14_Pol_135__9913D06E.mp3.asr_text: We got him coming from the west!

0255__L14_Ma3_140__7C93345A.mp3.asr_text: Hold them off! Ah! Ha! They're everywhere!

0259__L14_Sul_5__3DC4EECD.mp3.asr_text: Okay, stand by, Marines. We got incoming artillery to soften them up.
0259__L14_Sul_5__3DC4EECD.mp3.translation: 准备好，弟兄们。咱们的炮火先给他们松松筋骨。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 准备好，弟兄们。咱们的炮火先给他们松松筋骨。

0262__L13_Sul_20__8C722E24.mp3.asr_text: Why isn't that damn bunker out of action?
0262__L13_Sul_20__8C722E24.mp3.translation: 那座该死的碉堡怎么还没哑火？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 那座该死的碉堡怎么还没哑火？

0263__L14_Pol_30__20F39C9E.mp3.asr_text: We got an MG nest above the gate!
0263__L14_Pol_30__20F39C9E.mp3.translation: 城门上面有机枪火力点！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 城门上面有机枪火力点！

0264__L14_Pol_39__21727027.mp3.asr_text: DAMMIT WE GOTTA GET TO THAT GATE!
0264__L14_Pol_39__21727027.mp3.translation: 干啊，要冲到城门那儿去！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干啊，要冲到城门那儿去！

0265__L14_Sul_40__791F62A0.mp3.asr_text: Not with that MG nest in the way. Miller, get to the gate and set a charge. Rest of you men, cover him.
0265__L14_Sul_40__791F62A0.mp3.translation: 那个机枪火力点挡着，过不去。米勒，到城门那儿装炸药。其他人掩护他。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 那个机枪火力点挡着，过不去。米勒，到城门那儿装炸药。其他人掩护他。

0267__L14_Sul_102__0C31BF0B.mp3.asr_text: Keep going! Push him back to the building!
0267__L14_Sul_102__0C31BF0B.mp3.translation: 继续推进！把他们压回楼里！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 继续推进！把他们压回楼里！

0268__L14_Ma1_111__4EF9E3FC.mp3.asr_text: More of them in the windows!

0269__L14_Sul_112__0DE697AA.mp3.asr_text: There's no way through! We gotta find another way!

0272__L14_Ma1_147__546CFADF.mp3.asr_text: Hold on! Army Air Corps on the way!
0272__L14_Ma1_147__546CFADF.mp3.translation: 撑住！陆军航空队正在赶来！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 撑住！陆军航空队正在赶来！

0277__L14_Pol_159__9CB5DFB0.mp3.asr_text: So what now, Sergeant? Are we taking it all the way to Japan?
0277__L14_Pol_159__9CB5DFB0.mp3.translation: 中士，接下来呢？一路打到日本去？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，接下来呢？一路打到日本去？

0279__L14_Sul_14__743936C7.mp3.asr_text: Marines! We need to get to that bunker line! Step on it!
0279__L14_Sul_14__743936C7.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，要冲到那道碉堡防线！加快！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，要冲到那道碉堡防线！加快！

0284__L14_Sul_29__763484EB.mp3.asr_text: Push up! Watch the wall up ahead!

0285__L14_Sul_25__75FC26E7.mp3.asr_text: They've got nowhere to go! Keep pushing, man!
0285__L14_Sul_25__75FC26E7.mp3.translation: 他们没处跑了！弟兄们，继续压上去！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 他们没处跑了！弟兄们，继续压上去！

0288__L14_Sul_50__7AD43B3F.mp3.asr_text: Get back here and take cover, Miller!

0289__L14_Pol_43__22D2BBC0.mp3.asr_text: Come on, buddy! We got you covered!

0291__L14_Sul_56__7B28C845.mp3.asr_text: Okay, that's all of them! Get inside the castle!

0292__L14_Sul_66__7CDDA0E4.mp3.asr_text: Move up! Get up those stairs!

0293__L14_Sul_68__7CF9CFE6.mp3.asr_text: On the walls! More enemies! Watch out!

0296__L14_Sul_76__7E927983.mp3.asr_text: Easy, man. Take it slow. Remember, buy the numbers.
0296__L14_Sul_76__7E927983.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，稳住，慢点。记住，按步骤来。
0296__L14_Sul_76__7E927983.mp3.note: buy the numbers疑似by the numbers，按按步骤执行理解。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，稳住，慢点。记住，按步骤来。

0297__L14_Sul_77__7EA09104.mp3.asr_text: Miller, I want you on point. Go forward and take a look.
0297__L14_Sul_77__7EA09104.mp3.translation: 米勒，你打头阵。到前面看看。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 米勒，你打头阵。到前面看看。

0300__L14_Pol_123__9742C8CD.mp3.asr_text: Oh, nice place. How do you suppose it survived the bombing? You think any of the units made it this far, Sergeant?
0300__L14_Pol_123__9742C8CD.mp3.translation: 哟，好地方。怎么没被炸掉？中士，你说有别的部队打到这儿了吗？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 哟，好地方。怎么没被炸掉？中士，你说有别的部队打到这儿了吗？

0301__L14_Sul_127__0FE1E5CE.mp3.asr_text: Hear that? Artillery. Probably defending the temple. That's where we're going.
0301__L14_Sul_127__0FE1E5CE.mp3.translation: 听见没？炮声。他们大概在守那座寺庙，咱们就去那儿。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 听见没？炮声。他们大概在守那座寺庙，咱们就去那儿。

0303__L14_Sul_133__115E6069.mp3.asr_text: Okay, the guns look heavily defended. Won't help him though. Take him out.
0303__L14_Sul_133__115E6069.mp3.translation: 那些炮守得挺严，不过没用，端掉它们。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 那些炮守得挺严，不过没用，端掉它们。

0306__L14_Sul_143__13133908.mp3.asr_text: Hold on, Marines, hold on! Hold on!

0309__L14_Pol_141__9A904B09.mp3.asr_text: Cover me! Damn it! Over there!

0310__L14_Ma1_17__346CD317.mp3.translation: 他们都是从哪儿冒出来的？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 他们都是从哪儿冒出来的？

0312__L14_Sul_160__1652A3C3.mp3.asr_text: That's the plan, Polonsky. All the way to Tojo's doorstep.
0312__L14_Sul_160__1652A3C3.mp3.translation: 就是这么打算的，波隆斯基。一直打到东条英机家门口。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 就是这么打算的，波隆斯基。一直打到东条英机家门口。

0313__L14_Sul_0__3D7E7948.mp3.asr_text: Okay, Marines. That's Shuri Castle up ahead. Command wants us to take it, but since heavy resistance has been spotted inside, it goes by the numbers. You read me?
0313__L14_Sul_0__3D7E7948.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，前面就是首里城。指挥部要我们拿下它，里面守军不少，都给我按步骤来。听明白没有？
0313__L14_Sul_0__3D7E7948.mp3.note: 按ASR内容翻译；by the numbers为按训练步骤行动，不译成数字。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，前面就是首里城。指挥部要我们拿下它，里面守军不少，都给我按步骤来。听明白没有？

0316__L14_Sul_31__7778A182.mp3.asr_text: Get behind the wall for cover!

0317__L14_Sul_33__7794D084.mp3.asr_text: Heads down! Watch that MG fire!

0318__L14_Pol_35__213A1223.mp3.asr_text: This ain't exactly the best place to be pinned down!
0318__L14_Pol_35__213A1223.mp3.translation: 被压在这种地方可不是闹着玩的！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 被压在这种地方可不是闹着玩的！

0319__L14_Sul_93__81D1E43E.mp3.asr_text: They're charging us! Cut him down!
0319__L14_Sul_93__81D1E43E.mp3.translation: 他们冲过来了！拦住他们！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 他们冲过来了！拦住他们！

0322__L14_Sul_114__0E02C6AC.mp3.asr_text: Okay, Marines, we're moving out. Get to the staircase, on me!
0322__L14_Sul_114__0E02C6AC.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，继续走！到楼梯那儿去，跟上我！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，继续走！到楼梯那儿去，跟上我！

0323__L14_Sul_118__0E3B24B0.mp3.translation: 听好了弟兄们！穿过这扇门就是城堡庭院。轰炸机随时待命，要把这儿夷为平地。咱们要冲进去，完成清剿后立刻撤离。绝不能出任何岔子！波隆斯基，把门打开！
0323__L14_Sul_118__0E3B24B0.mp3.note: ASR因超长跳过。未使用AM旧稿补写，待补识别或听音。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 听好了弟兄们！穿过这扇门就是城堡庭院。轰炸机随时待命，要把这儿夷为平地。咱们要冲进去，完成清剿后立刻撤离。绝不能出任何岔子！波隆斯基，把门打开！

0324__L14_Sul_120__0F7F4147.mp3.asr_text: The rest of you, keep your eyes open.

0325__L14_Pol_139__994C2E72.mp3.asr_text: You ain't getting me without a fight!

0326__L14_Pol_148__9AF2EF90.mp3.asr_text: What do you know? Here come the Flyboys!

0328__L14_Sul_3__3DA8BFCB.mp3.asr_text: Could be a hundred in there, could be a thousand. Enough to keep us busy, that's for sure.
0328__L14_Sul_3__3DA8BFCB.mp3.translation: 可能一百，也可能一千。反正够咱们忙一阵的。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 可能一百，也可能一千。反正够咱们忙一阵的。
